claim: The Last Supper canvas is viewable free of charge in the abbey church Mon-Sat 8-11am and 1-5pm, Sundays 8-10am and 1-5pm, with a push-button 5-minute timer light in the side aisle; abbey address is Abdijstraat 40, 2260 Tongerlo, Belgium.
quote: The painting is displayed in the abbey church: Weekdays (Mon-Sat): 8-11 am and 1-5 pm; Sundays: 8-10 am and 1-5 pm. The light can be switched on with a push button in the side aisle (5 min. timer). Free admission.

claim: Tongerlo Abbey was founded c.1130 by Norbertines from Sint-Michielsabdij in Antwerp on the estate of Giselbert van Castelré; the community was dissolved in 1796 during the French Revolution and re-established in 1838-1840.
quote: De Abdij van Tongerlo is een norbertijnenabdij bij het dorp Tongerlo in de Belgische gemeente Westerlo. De abdij werd gesticht rond 1130, toen een aantal norbertijnen van de Sint-Michielsabdij te Antwerpen zich vestigden op het landgoed van heer Giselbert van Castelré.

claim: The Tongerlo Last Supper canvas measures just over 8 x 4 meters and was painted 1507-1508 in Milan; recent multispectral and IRR analysis by Jean-Pierre Isbouts attributes details such as St. John's face directly to Leonardo, with Giampietrino, Andrea Solario and Marco d'Oggiono identified as collaborators.
quote: The canvas measures just over 8 x 4 meters, created between 1507-1508 in Milan as a replica of the famous mural. Giampietrino, Andrea Solario and Marco d'Oggiono were identified as the principal collaborators of da Vinci's Milanese studio.

claim: The Da Vinci Museum closed on 1 November 2021 for canvas restoration; since summer 2025 the Last Supper hangs again in the abbey church, while the Tiendschuur (tithe barn) shows a full-scale high-resolution photographic reproduction.
quote: The Da Vinci museum closed on November 1, 2021 for restoration and relocation of the Last Supper, with the restoration of the canvas completed in early 2025. Since summer 2025, Leonardo da Vinci's masterpiece shines again in full glory in Tongerlo on its new old location: in the abbey church.

claim: Public guided tours run every first Sunday of the month (April-October) at 2pm from the abbey gate for 6 euros (free for under-12s); group tours of 25 people cost 70 euros, last 90 minutes and cover the inner courtyard, tithe barn and abbey church, bookable via Toerisme Westerlo with three weeks' notice.
quote: Every first Sunday of the month at 2 PM, guides welcome visitors at the abbey gate for a guided walk on the inner courtyard. Tickets cost 6 euros. The cost for groups is 70 euros per 25 people. The guided tour lasts 90 minutes and covers the inner courtyard, tithe barn, and abbey church.

claim: Tongerlo abbey beer has been brewed by Brouwerij Haacht in Boortmeerbeek since 1990 and carries the Recognized Belgian Abbey Beer label since 1999; on-site brewing at the abbey ended in WWI when the occupier confiscated the copper kettles.
quote: Tongerlo is a Belgian abbey beer that is brewed at Brouwerij Haacht in Boortmeerbeek in accordance with the Abbey of Tongerlo. This beer has carried the label of Recognized Belgian Abbey Beer since 1999. The brewing in the abbey came to a final end when during World War I, the occupier confiscated the copper brewing kettles.

claim: On-site amenities at the abbey include a bookshop called De Oude Linden in a converted carriage house, plus a bakery; the abbey church dates to 1852 and the complex spans buildings from the 15th to 18th centuries.
quote: The abbey features a bakery and hostel bakery. A bookshop called De Oude Linden operates in a converted carriage house. The abbey includes a church (built 1852), meeting house for group retreats, and multiple historic buildings spanning from the 15th to 18th centuries.

claim: Torenhof Brasserie sits directly opposite the Tongerlo Abbey gate, serving Flemish and Belgian seasonal dishes with a children's menu, and operates an adjacent bakery and ice-cream café in the park garden.
quote: Torenhof Brasserie. Situated in Westerlo, tegenover de Abdij van Tongerlo (opposite Tongerlo Abbey). The establishment features an extensive menu offering Vlaamse en Belgische gerechten (Flemish and Belgian dishes) with seasonal ingredients and regional products.

claim: Abbot Arnoud Streyters purchased the Last Supper canvas in 1545 for 450 Rhenish florins; it is considered the most faithful replica of Leonardo's original because the Milan fresco has heavily deteriorated.
quote: The abbey has housed the most faithful and most beautiful replica of the Last Supper, which Leonardo da Vinci painted since 1545. This copy is valuable because the original fresco in Milan's Santa Maria delle Grazie has deteriorated significantly over time.

claim: Kasteel Prins de Merode is a private residence of Prince Simon de Merode, normally closed to the public, opened exceptionally for Kerstmagie in December and Historalia productions every two years in summer.
quote: Het kasteeldomein wordt uitzonderlijk opengesteld in het kader van Kerstmagie elk jaar in december

claim: An English landscape park of 12 hectares surrounds the castle with ponds connected to the moat, and a larger 60-hectare formal French-style park lies across the Nete river featuring a rectangular reflection pond.
quote: An English landscape park of 12 hectares surrounds the castle. The ponds in the park are connected with the moat of the castle. Additionally, across the Nete river there is a larger formal park (60 hectares) in the French tradition with a rectangular pond

claim: Jean Philippe Eugène de Merode (1674-1732) designed the park in front of the castle and built its large lake around 1710 after visiting Versailles, creating a mix of styles unique in Belgium.
quote: designed the park which extends in front the Castle... built a large lake in the Castle's parkland... a mix of styles [that] is unique in Belgium

claim: The Kasteelfeesten — the principal day on which the private castle and park open to the public — runs the first weekend of July (45th edition Saturday 6 and Sunday 7 July), with ~6,000 visitors, ~100 exhibitors, tickets 8 euros and free entry for under-14s.
quote: Op zaterdag 6 en zondag 7 juli vindt de 45ste editie van de Kasteelfeesten plaats op het kasteeldomein de Merode... Toegangstickets kosten 8 euro. Kinderen jonger dan 14 jaar mogen gratis binnen.

claim: Kerstmagie is an annual December event where visitors tour the castle for about an hour following a Christmas storyline guided by costumed characters, with a winter bar and stalls run by local clubs in the courtyard.
quote: an annual event for all ages... wandering through the castle for approximately one hour, encountering costumed characters and festively decorated spaces

claim: Kasteel Jeanne de Merode, the neo-Gothic 1909-1911 'New Castle' that has served as Westerlo's town hall since 1972, is freely accessible during municipal opening hours and during regular exhibitions; groups can book guided tours via Toerisme Westerlo.
quote: accessible during the opening hours of the municipal administrative services and during exhibitions that regularly take place

claim: The De Merode walking network counts roughly 700 km of waymarked paths across three provinces, billed as the most popular walking area in Flanders, and connects to the Hagelandse Heuvels, Demer en Dijle, Kempense Netevallei, Grote Netewoud and Limburg networks.
quote: 700 kilometers of walking paths across 3 provinces in Flanders, making it 'the most popular walking area in Flanders.'

claim: Landschapspark de Merode straddles three provinces (Antwerp, Limburg, Flemish Brabant) and nine municipalities — Aarschot, Diest, Geel, Herselt, Hulshout, Laakdal, Scherpenheuvel-Zichem, Tessenderlo-Ham and Westerlo — covering ~1,500 ha of forest and farmland once owned by the de Merode family.
quote: Landschapspark de Merode lies on the border of three provinces: Antwerp, Limburg, and Flemish Brabant. The Landscape Park extends over nine municipalities: Aarschot, Diest, Geel, Herselt, Hulshout, Laakdal, Scherpenheuvel-Zichem, Tessenderlo-Ham and Westerlo

claim: The De Merode walking network passes between junction points 12 and 13 along the Grote Nete bank, offering scenic exterior views of the castle and its mirror pond (spiegelvijver) for visitors who cannot enter the grounds.
quote: Between walking junction points 12 and 13 of the de Merode walking network, hikers can walk along the Grote Nete riverbank with scenic views of 'het kasteel en de spiegelvijver'

claim: Westerlo's Sint-Lambertuskerk is a basilical cross church whose choir dates to 1416 with a nave from the 16th century and tower rebuilt in 1760; it was restored 1890-1904 with a private chapel and burial chapel for the de Merode family, and protected as a monument in 1976.
quote: Het koor van de neogotisch herbouwde kerk dateert uit 1416, het schip uit de zestiende eeuw, de toren werd in 1760 herbouwd... van 1890 tot 1904 werd de kerk gerestaureerd en uitgebreid met een privékapel voor gravin Jeanne de Merode en een grafkapel voor de familie de Merode

claim: The Grote Markt in Westerlo is an elongated triangular Frankish-origin square that hosts a weekly Wednesday morning market with around one hundred stalls selling fresh food, household goods and textiles.
quote: Het marktplein van Westerlo heeft de vorm van een langgerekte driehoek... Elke woensdagvoormiddag worden de Grote Markt en de omliggende straten ingenomen door een honderdtal marktkramers

claim: Westerlo's village shopping concentrates along Gravin de Merodestraat and Boerenkrijglaan, with fashion, gift and flower shops, hair salons and convenience stores within walking distance of one another.
quote: De handel concentreert zich langs de Gravin de Merodestraat en de Boerenkrijglaan, waar mode-, cadeau- en bloemenzaken, kapsalons en buurtwinkels op wandelafstand van elkaar liggen.

claim: Three major cycle networks (Kempen, Hageland and Limburgse Kempen) cross Landschapspark de Merode, and the dedicated mountain-bike network covers 231 km linking through to Hageland and Kempen.
quote: Landschapspark de Merode is crossed by 3 major cycling networks: Kempen, Hageland, and the Limburgse Kempen, and mountain bikers can enjoy 123km of mountain bike trails. The mountain bike network of de Merode is 231 km long

claim: Natuurpunt manages over 100 ha of the Averbode Bos en Heide reserve, with two marked routes using the De Merode knooppunt system: a blue ~4.3 km (60 min) loop and a red ~11.2 km (170 min) loop starting at Abdijstraat 1 in Averbode.
quote: Blauwe route: ongeveer 4,3 km, ongeveer 60 min ... Rode route: ongeveer 11,2 km, ongeveer 170 min ... Startpunt: Abdijstraat 1, Averbode

claim: Natuurpunt manages 593 ha at Averbode Bos & Heide, which forms part of an interconnected nature complex of more than 1,500 ha across three provinces, acquired in 2004 by the Vlaamse Landmaatschappij from the de Merode family and being restored from Corsican pine monoculture to heath, dunes, fens and grassland.
quote: Averbode Bos & Heide is één van de deelgebieden die in 2004 door de Vlaamse Landmaatschappij overgekocht zijn van de familie de Merode

claim: The EU LIFE habitat-restoration project at Averbode (LIFE06 NAT/B/000081, 2006-2012) restored more than 10 ha of open dunes, 58 ha of heathland and 21 ha of Nardus grassland; the nightjar has returned as a breeding bird.
quote: more than 10 ha of open dunes, 58 ha of heathland, and 21 ha of Nardus grassland were restored

claim: Abdij Averbode was founded in 1134 as a 'double monastery' of Norbertine (Premonstratensian) canons and is still home to 55 community members; the inner courtyard and abbey church are freely accessible mornings until 11:30 and afternoons from 14:00.
quote: De Abdij Averbode werd gesticht in 1134 als 'dubbelklooster'

claim: The abbey complex hosts Het Moment, with the Abdijcafé Het Moment serving artisanal snacks and drinks on a terrace overlooking the abbey, plus an on-site brewery, cheese ripening, and bakery.
quote: In het abdijcafé 'Het Moment' ben je welkom voor ambachtelijke hapjes en drankjes

claim: Abdij Averbode sits at the busiest walking knooppunt in Flanders, making it the natural launchpad for hiking and cycling tours into Averbode Bos en Heide.
quote: De abdij van Averbode is gelegen aan het drukst bewandelde wandelknooppunt van Vlaanderen

claim: De Beeltjens, the 'backyard of Westerlo', is a 127 ha forest area with star-shaped tree-lined avenues laid out in the early 18th century by Jan Philips Eugeen de Merode and includes Asberg, the municipality's highest point at 24 m, plus the Gravinnekespad sensory trail for children aged 3-10.
quote: De Beeltjens is dé achtertuin van Westerlo ... Het hoogste punt van de gemeente, de Asberg, een zandduin van 24 meter hoog, ligt in De Beeltjens

claim: A signposted Westerlo walking loop links De Beeltjens with the Kwarekken meadow and Grote Nete valley, combining castle park, mixed forest and river meanders in roughly 7 km.
quote: Westerlo: De Beeltjens en de Kwarekken

claim: Provinciaal Groendomein Hertberg lies on the Diestsebaan at the meeting point of Antwerpen, Vlaams-Brabant and Limburg, freely accessible with walking, cycling, mountain-biking and horse-riding networks, and a 'Stoerparcours' nature experience trail aimed at children aged 10-14.
quote: Door het domein kan je gebruik maken van wandel- en fietsknooppunten, ruiter- en mountainbikenetwerken

claim: The signposted 'Rondje Hertberg' walking route through the Provinciaal Groendomein Hertberg uses the De Merode knooppunten and passes Herberg Mie Maan, a café/restaurant on the Diestsebaan that doubles as the trailhead car park.
quote: Rondje Hertberg

claim: Hof ter Laken in Booischot (Heist-op-den-Berg) is a 30 ha castle estate south of the Grote Nete with a neo-Flemish Renaissance castle, monumental linden avenue, walled orchard and forest chapel; the park has been freely accessible from sunrise to sunset since October 2018.
quote: Het 30 hectare grote park ... is sinds oktober 2018 opengesteld voor het publiek

claim: Kempens Landschap, VRT and Toerisme Vlaanderen produced a 5.4 km, ~90-minute PodWalk audio walking route 'Dwars door Hof Ter Laken' through the Booischot estate.
quote: podwalk ... een route van 5,4 kilometer door het majestueuze domein in ongeveer 90 minuten

claim: The Kempen fietsknooppunten network covers more than 2,000 km of signposted cycling paths with around thirty designated entry points; in spring 2026 the Flemish provinces rolled out an updated network and a new provincial cycling map (field adjustments January-March 2026, new map end of March 2026).
quote: fietsknooppuntennetwerk ... meer dan 2.000 kilometer fietspaden

claim: Toerisme Westerlo distributes pre-planned themed cycling routes built on the knooppunt network (e.g. the Sant-Dimpna route) via brochures and downloads, with the Routedokter service for reporting damaged signage.
quote: Sant-Dimpna Route

claim: Komoot's Westerlo cycling guide ranks the area among the Kempen's best loops, with multiple recommended 30-50 km tours starting from the village square and connecting De Beeltjens, the Grote Nete valley and Averbode Bos en Heide via the knooppunt network.
quote: Top 10 Bike Rides and Cycling Routes around Westerlo

claim: Abdij van Postel (Mol) lies roughly 35-40 km north-east of Westerlo - just outside the 30 km radius - and offers five waymarked walks of 3 to 12 km from the abbey gate through the Postelse Bossen.
quote: 5 walking routes between 3 and 12 km that all start at the entrance gate of the Abbey

claim: Hageven-De Plateaux is a 600 ha cross-border heath, fen, forest and grassland reserve in Pelt with five waymarked walks of 1.5-9.7 km from visitor centre De Wulp; at ~55 km from Westerlo it falls outside the 30 km radius and is better treated as a separate excursion.
quote: oase van 600 hectare met heide, vennen, bossen en graslanden

claim: Lier's Zimmertoren houses Louis Zimmer's astronomical Centenary Clock and the Astronomical Studio, a marquee combined-ticket Lier sight.
quote: The tower got its current name and function in the 1930s, when Belgian clockmaker and astronomer Louis Zimmer installed an astronomical clock in it.

claim: Lier's Begijnhof, founded 1258 with 11 streets and 162 houses, was inscribed by UNESCO in 1998.
quote: Founded in 1258, it has 11 streets and 162 houses, as well as a convent and an infirmary. In 1998 it was recognised as a World Heritage Site by UNESCO.

claim: The Liers Vlaaike is a 300-year-old spiced regional pastry, recognised as a Flemish regional product (2007) and at EU level (2013).
quote: The Lier Vlaaike is a spicy pastry made with candy syrup and four spices that goes back more than 300 years and is one of the oldest regional pastries from the province of Antwerp.

claim: The Museum Wuyts-Van Campen & Baron Caroly in Lier was closed in February 2018, so it is no longer a planning option.
quote: At the end of February 2018, the Stedelijk Museum Wuyts-Van Campen & Baron Caroly was closed.

claim: Diest's Sint-Sulpitiuskerk (1320-1537) holds the tomb of Philip William of Orange-Nassau and a Religious Art museum in the choir.
quote: The monumental Sint-Sulpitiuskerk was built between 1320 and 1537 in local ironstone and white sandstone. For the main altar lies the tomb of Prince Philip William of Orange-Nassau, Lord of Diest.

claim: Diest's Groot Begijnhof, founded 1253, is UNESCO-listed and among the largest beguinages in the world.
quote: Diest is home to the Diest Beguinage, a tranquil complex founded in 1253 and recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage site. The Diest beguinage is one of the largest in the world.

claim: Diest's mid-19th-century citadel (1845-53) is described as the only European citadel where the defence system and architecture still survive intact.
quote: The citadel is the only citadel in Europe whose defence system and architecture still survive, with the main part built in 1845-53.

claim: Diest's only in-walls brewery is Loterbol, visitable on the first Saturday of the month - a small craft-beer draw rather than a major attraction.
quote: Diest has about 24,000 inhabitants and as far as I can see only one brewery and no distilleries within these old town ramparts. Loterbol is the only brewery, which you can visit on the first Saturday of the month.

claim: Turnhout's National Museum of the Playing Card showcases the city's heritage as one of the world's largest card producers (1.3 million packs/day), with antique printing machines on display.
quote: Turnhout was one of the world's largest producers of playing cards (1.3 million packs per day), and the museum displays a range of antique industrial printing machines used in card creation, including a vast steam-powered drive wheel.

claim: Turnhout's Kasteel van de Hertogen van Brabant dates from the 13th century but requires a 3-week-advance group booking and is not open to walk-in visitors.
quote: The castle is not open to the general public and requires a minimum of 3 weeks advance reservation as a group, and can only be visited under the guidance of a guide.

claim: Of the six candidate towns only Lier, Diest, and Turnhout sit on the 13-site UNESCO Flemish Beguinages list; Herentals, Aarschot, and Geel do not.
quote: Brugge, Dendermonde, Diest, Gent (Klein Begijnhof), Hoogstraten, Kortrijk, Leuven (Groot Begijnhof), Lier, Mechelen (Groot Begijnhof), Sint-Amandsberg, Sint-Truiden, Tongeren, Turnhout

claim: Herentals's original 13th-c. beguinage was destroyed in the Eighty Years' War; the present beguinage was rebuilt in the 17th century with a museum building open by appointment only.
quote: The original Begijnhof from the thirteenth century lay a small kilometer further north, but was destroyed during the Eighty Years' War. The current Begijnhof was built in the seventeenth century.

claim: Herentals's Sint-Catharinakerk in the beguinage is only freely visitable Fri-Sun 14:00-17:00 from 1 June to 30 September; outside that window guided tours only.
quote: The Sint-Catharinakerk in the Begijnhof can be visited from June 1 to September 30 on Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays from 2 to 5 PM. Outside these hours, the church can only be visited with a guide.

claim: Geel's Sint-Dimpna church (begun 1349) and the Gasthuismuseum embody a unique medieval-rooted family-foster-care tradition still housing close to 500 psychiatric patients with townspeople today.
quote: A modern psychiatric centre now stands on the place of the old infirmary, with close to 500 patients still placed with inhabitants.

claim: Geel's Gasthuismuseum is housed in the former infirmary attached to Sint-Dimpnakerk and tells the story of medieval pilgrim care that evolved into the modern foster-family psychiatric model.
quote: An infirmary leans against the south side of the church's tower, where pilgrims who came seeking favor from the saint would find shelter for nine days.

claim: Aarschot's Onze-Lieve-Vrouwekerk is a gothic church built 1337-1450 in distinctive ironstone, damaged in both World Wars and restored 1971-87.
quote: This imposing gothic building was constructed between 1337 and 1450. The construction began in the early 14th century, with a foundation stone in the choir apse from 1337 mentioning French master builder Jacob Piccart.

claim: Aarschot's beguinage, founded ~1259, was largely destroyed in WWII; only the 17th-c. 'Zeven Weeën' row (nos. 15-19) remains intact, making it a ruin/fragment rather than a UNESCO-grade ensemble.
quote: During World War II, the courtyard was largely destroyed; only the section 'Zeven Weeën' (Beguinage numbers 15-19) was relatively well preserved, with 17th-century row houses featuring typical cross windows and distinctive rounded door openings.

claim: Lier's compact old town lets visitors walk between Zimmertoren, Begijnhof and Sint-Gummaruskerk in roughly 15 minutes, making it an efficient half-day cultural circuit.
quote: Most sights, from the Zimmertoren clock tower to the Beguinage, are within a 15-minute stroll.

claim: Bobbejaanland in Lichtaart offers a single-day ticket promotion at €28.90 (regular €49.90) with code OPEN26, with featured rides including Revolution, Fury, Typhoon, Wild Water Slide and Terra Magma across themed areas Land of Legends and Adventure Valley.
quote: € 28,90 instead of € 49.90 with code OPEN26 ... Revolution, Fury, Typhoon, Wild Water Slide, and Terra Magma, plus themed areas like Land of Legends and Adventure Valley.

claim: Typhoon at Bobbejaanland is a Gerstlauer Euro-Fighter coaster with a 97-degree vertical drop, loop, double heartline roll and 540-degree helix, opened 10 April 2004.
quote: Typhoon roller coaster, a Euro-Fighter model from Gerstlauer, includes a vertical lift to the 97° drop followed by a loop, double heartline roll, 540° helix, another heartline roll and a final helix. It opened on 10 April 2004

claim: Fury is a Gerstlauer triple-launch coaster at Bobbejaanland, 43 m tall, top speed 106.6 km/h, opened 24 June 2019, where riders can vote to ride forwards or backwards.
quote: Fury is a triple launch coaster manufactured by Gerstlauer which opened on 24 June 2019. This impressive new ride is 43 m (141 ft) tall and reaches a top speed of 106.6 km/h ... allows riders to vote on whether to experience the ride forwards or backwards.

claim: Zilvermeer Mol is a provincial recreation domain with a sandy-beach swimming pond that becomes deep only gradually, plus go-carts, mini-golf, rowing, water bikes, and a separate water sports pond for sailing/surfing/kayaking by group reservation.
quote: swimming pond features a climbing tower, water slides, whirlpools and a fine white sand beach ... swimming, go-carting, mini-golfing, rowing, and water biking available, and sailing, surfing, and kayaking can be done on the water sports pond

claim: The Lommel Sahara in Bosland National Park offers three marked trails from the House of Nature: blue 3.8 km family/play-forest loop, orange 5.7 km, and red 11.7 km (awarded most beautiful hike in Belgium) — swimming in the lakes is forbidden.
quote: Blue Route (3.8 km): 45-minute easy walk ideal for families ... Red Route (11.7 km): 3-hour medium trek 'awarded as the most beautiful hike in Belgium' ... Swimming is prohibited due to dangerous currents and unstable banks.

claim: Sunparks Kempense Meren in Mol includes the Aquafun swimming paradise with wave pool, rapids and water slides, a Kids World indoor play facility, and walking/cycling routes through the Stille Kempen forests.
quote: Swimming paradise with water slide, rapids and wave pool ... Kids World indoor play facility with unlimited access included ... walking and cycling routes throughout the Stille Kempen forests

claim: Sunparks Kempense Meren has 610 rooms/villas, 4 on-site restaurants, free water park access, bowling alley, beach bar, archery and racquetball, and the Aquafun 'Black Hole' dark slide with light/sound effects.
quote: free water park access, a bowling alley, and a beach bar ... Aquafun swimming paradise which features the exclusive Black Hole, a super slide in the dark with special light and sound effects ... 4 on-site restaurants ... All 610 rooms

claim: Plopsa Indoor Hasselt is an all-weather family park aimed at toddlers through early-elementary children with 25+ indoor and outdoor attractions including the Wickie Coaster, Maya/Bumba shows and a Studio 100 meet & greet; dated tickets from €24, undated €32, family tickets from €25 pp for groups of 3–6.
quote: Standard tickets: Starting from €24 (dated) or €32 (undated with 1-year validity) - Family tickets: From €25 per person for groups of 3-6 ... more than 25 indoor and outdoor attractions ... Wickie Coaster (indoor roller coaster)

claim: Provinciaal Domein Prinsenpark in Retie is a 215-hectare free-access green domain in the Antwerpse Kempen with an adventure play forest where children can build camps, plus toddler-safe play areas, picnic tables and walking routes past ponds and viewing huts.
quote: Prinsenpark is a beautiful domain of 215 hectares in the Antwerp Kempen ... adventure playground (speelbos) where children can build camps and play hide-and-seek among ferns ... freely accessible every day from sunrise to sunset

claim: Kabouterberg in Kasterlee is a free-entry forest play area with sand hills, climbing terrain, a maze and a 1.5 km gnome-themed walk best for ages 3–7; Kasterlee is 21 km / ~17 min by road from Westerlo.
quote: Kabouterberg in Kasterlee features play areas, climbing opportunities, sand heaps, a maze, and picnic spots in the forest. Admission is free ... walking route suitable for children aged 3-7 ... distance from Kasterlee to Westerlo is 21 kilometers

claim: Goodwill Karting in Olen offers a 600 m indoor/outdoor track with a banked corner and electronic lap timing, single sessions at €13 for 12 minutes — one of the cheapest indoor kartings in Belgium.
quote: 600 meters of racing with tight corners, long straights, and a legendary banked turn ... Single sessions are priced at 13 euros for 12 minutes, making it one of the cheapest indoor kartings in Belgium

claim: BattleKart Herentals offers electric go-karts on an interactive track with virtual landscapes and gameplay bonuses projected on the ground; no minimum age but a 1.45 m minimum height to drive.
quote: BattleKart Herentals offers electric go-kart racing with virtual landscape interactions and bonuses projected on the ground. There's no minimum age but you must be at least 1.45m tall to play.

claim: Padel Club 360 in Westerlo provides 5 outdoor padel courts available for booking directly in the village.
quote: Padel Club 360 Westerlo is a padel venue with 5 courts (5 outdoor)

claim: Averbode abbey beer is bottled by Brewery Huyghe in Melle, but a draught house beer is brewed in a micro-brewery inside the abbey café 'Het Moment' and is only available on site.
quote: The bottled version is brewed at Brewery Huyghe in Melle but the draught house beer is brewed in the micro-brewery you can see inside the abbey café. The house beer is not available in bottles and can only be tasted here.

claim: Het Moment Averbode houses an abbey café with on-site micro-brewery, cheese factory, bakery and abbey shop selling beer, cheese, bread and gingerbread — only ~8 km from Westerlo.
quote: Old service buildings were given a new purpose: they now house an abbey café with in-house brewery, a cheese factory, a bakery and an abbey shop.

claim: Hertog Jan brewery is located in Arcen, Netherlands (not Belgium) and is owned by AB InBev since 1995 — too far for a Tongerlo day trip.
quote: In 1995 it became part of the international Interbrew (later InBev, now Anheuser–Busch InBev) group... renamed Hertog Jan Brouwerij in 1998.

claim: Westmalle Trappist abbey and brewery are not open to general public visitors except one annual open day; the brewery is at Antwerpsesteenweg 496, 2390 Malle, roughly 28 km from Westerlo (edge of the 30 km radius).
quote: the Westmalle Abbey and Brewery are not open to visitors, with the only exception being an annual open day

claim: Café Trappisten, directly opposite the Westmalle brewery gate at Antwerpsesteenweg 487, is open Monday–Sunday 10:00–24:00 and serves Extra, Dubbel, Tripel plus abbey cheese; seats up to 1,200 with a large terrace.
quote: Antwerpsesteenweg 487, Westmalle... open Monday through Sunday from 10:00 am to 12:00 am... can accommodate 1,200 people and has a large outdoor terrace

claim: Duvel Moortgat brewery tours run at the Puurs-Sint-Amands site (Breendonk-Dorp 58, 2870), with Saturday slots at 11:00 and 14:00 — but the location is ~44 km from Westerlo, outside the 30 km radius.
quote: Saturday: 11 AM and 2 PM ... Duration: 2 hours, Cost: €18 per person

claim: Distance from Puurs to Westerlo is 44 km straight-line / 65 km by road — confirming Duvel Moortgat is well beyond the 30 km radius.
quote: The distance between Puurs and Westerlo is 44 kilometers (27 miles), with the driving distance from Puurs to Westerlo being 65 kilometers (40 miles)

claim: Brouwerij Pirlot at Heistraat 3, 2240 Zandhoven brews the Kempisch Vuur range; visits are by appointment for groups of 15–30 at €10 pp for tour plus three tastings (smaller groups get a brewer's film at €7).
quote: Heistraat 3, 2240 Zandhoven... price for a short presentation, brewery tour, and tasting of three samples of different beers is €10 per person

claim: Brouwerij Leysen at Meivuurstraat 2, Herentals (Kempen) brews the Baskwadder blond/dubbel/tripel range; standard hours include Thursday 18:00–21:00 and weekend by appointment, with a Streketour stop on Sun 25 May 2026.
quote: Streketour... Sunday, May 25, 2026. Visitors can taste beers and spirits, tour the brewery and distillery

claim: Brouwerij Haacht in Boortmeerbeek runs guided tours Mon–Thu only for groups of 15–50 at €19 pp adult, ending with two drinks at Brasserie Brouwershof — but Boortmeerbeek is ~35 km south of Westerlo, just outside the 30 km radius.
quote: You can visit Haacht Brewery from Monday until Thursday... adults pay €19... two free drinks at Brasserie Brouwershof

claim: Lier holds a Saturday market on and around the Grote Markt every Saturday from 08:00 to 12:30 with fresh produce, flowers, textiles and leather — ~22 km from Westerlo.
quote: every Saturday on and around the Grand Place... operates between 8 and 12:30

claim: Westerlo's own weekly market runs on Wednesday (not Saturday/Sunday), so weekend visitors should head to Lier for a market experience.
quote: Wekelijkse marktdag op woensdag

claim: Chocolaterie Lornoy at Zandstraat 64, Herentals is a Gault&Millau-listed artisanal chocolatier known for melocakes in twenty flavours, pralines and 'paardenkoppen' — ~12 km from Westerlo.
quote: Chocolaterie Lornoy... assortment of pralines, melocakes in twenty flavors, and small paardenkoppen

claim: Tongerlo Abbey's shop 'De Oude Linden' (restored grain barn) sells Tongerlo beer, abbey honey, jams and liqueurs, but unlike Averbode you cannot drink the beer inside the abbey walls.
quote: Unlike Averbode Abbey, you cannot taste the Tongerlo beer within the abbey walls

claim: Westerlo's tourism listing counts 31 cafés, 34 brasseries and 16 restaurants, including Alice Gastronomia (Grote Markt 26B) and Hotel Geerts (Grote Markt 50) on the central square; Torenhof sits in Tongerlo village.
quote: Brasserie (34)... Café (31)... Alice Gastronomia – Grote Markt 26 B, 2260 Westerlo
